name: xsrev
description: Cross-sectional short-term reversal (1-3 day losers long / winners short) on the PIT top-30 perps, daily or 3-day rebalance, beta-hedged or dollar-neutral, vol-targeted to 20%.
mechanism: Short-term reversal: 1-3 day losers bounce and winners give back (liquidity provision to overreacting flow). Tested as the mirror of xsmom on the same universe.

wf.frozen_rule: most chosen across folds (5/7), ties by median train rank

null.kind: random longs/shorts from the same eligible set, same k/hedge/rebalance/vol target

implementability_200.note: missing = not listed on Bybit linear today (delisted or renamed, e.g. 1000SHIBUSDT is SHIB1000USDT on Bybit); those legs are simulated unrounded

caveats: Stitched WF OOS 2022-01..2025-06: Sharpe -0.36, CAGR -9.3%, maxDD -46%. All 24 configs are negative over the dev period (median dev Sharpe -1.64, best -0.59). Deflated Sharpe 0.005.
On daily bars in this universe 1-3 day returns CONTINUE (see xsmom) rather than revert; daily rebalancing adds 25-39%/yr of fee drag on top.
Null percentile 87 vs random L/S books (p=0.14) only because random books are worse (null mean -0.69).
Kept as a separate module (strategies/xsrev.py, 24 trials) so momentum and reversal each carry their own n_trials; it is the reversal variant of the xsmom task.

causality.walk_forward_guard: passed (walk_forward raises on a causality breach)

correlation.btc_trend_def: BTC 1x long when the prior daily close > SMA100, else flat, no costs

trade_stats_basis: stitched WF OOS, per-symbol round trips (a pair trade = 2)
